dedupe_keys.name: jordan ministry of energy and mineral resources open tables electricity generation and peak load renewable energy projects energy balance gas and oil flows 2015 2025

description: The Jordanian Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources publishes 86 datasets on the national open government data portal, forming yearly energy statistics tables. Contents: electricity generation and peak load, sectoral shares of electricity consumption, installed capacity of renewable energy projects and a list of renewable projects, daily average natural gas use in power generation and industry, natural gas imports and production (Risha field), crude oil and petroleum product imports, production, consumption and stock ratios, primary and final energy consumption and cost, the energy balance, fuel selling prices, counts of solar panels and household solar water heaters by sector, plus geological and oil shale reports and maps. Producer: the ministry's statistics and planning units. Coverage: Jordan, years 2015 to 2025, one table per indicator and year. Format and access: XLSX, CSV and PDF downloads from the portal, whose CKAN API accepts POST requests only. Free under the portal's default open licence. Caveats: tables are annual summaries split into many small files with inconsistent layouts and Arabic text, some CSV files are in Windows Arabic encoding, and there is no plant-level or network data. Simulation uses: calibrating national energy system and electricity demand models, peak load and gas dependency scenarios (for example supply interruptions from pipeline imports), and tracking renewable build-out. Related records: the Ministry of Water and Irrigation tables (data-jordan-mwi-dams-wastewater-plants-water-budget-tables) for the water side of the energy-water nexus.
